why: Drops the running-session guard issue #690 asks for. It is also the exactly-once rule: a throw on the Main Menu would draw the match-failed overlay over a menu with no match, and a failed start that `onStartFailure` already showed -- which leaves the host empty -- would be reported a second time if the same throw also reached the window.
killedBy: boot: an uncaught error during a running match (issue #690) reports a failure once, however many events it raises, and nothing with no session running
boot: an uncaught error during a running match (issue #690) does not report again a failed start that boot already handled
